description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's regularized lower incomplete gamma. ERF.PRECISE(x) = GAMMA.DIST(x^2,0.5,1,TRUE) bit-for-bit (probe kmyst-erf-gamma), so this dissects GAMMA.DIST. A = z (m*2^-60, m*2^-30, m/64); B = z^0.5; C..J = GAMMA.DIST(z,a,1,TRUE) for a = 0.5,1,2,3,1.5,0.25,2.5,10; K..N = densities for a = 0.5,1.5,2,3; O = SQRT(z); P = EXP(0.5*LN(z)); Q = 1-EXP(-z); R = GAMMA.DIST(z,1,1,TRUE)-Q. T..W = GAMMA/GAMMALN at a and a+1.
